body:
After being diagnosed with a mood disorder I was prescribed Zyprexa.  At that time in my life I was drinking regularly and decided that since I was going to be drinking anyway I might as well down the the pill with a beer or two.
I immediatly felt like something was wrong.  I was completely disoriented and within an hour there was a horrible sharp pain in my head.  It felt like there was a solitary ice-cold beetle quickly burrowing a maze through my brain.
I continued taking the reccomended dosage for my mood disorder, but the symptoms persisted.  This is an anti-psychotic/anti seizure drug.  Don't be afraid to tell your doctor if it's not right for you.
